law_name: Law of Georgia on Copyright and Related Rights (Law No. 2112-IIS of 22 June 1999, as amended)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (anonymous/pseudonymous works: 70 years from publication)
digital_protection: Art. 4 defines technological measures and circumvention; circumvention, trafficking in devices and removing electronic RMI are infringements (article no. unverified) (unconfirmed)
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list: personal copying (art. 21), quotation, criticism, teaching extracts (art. 23)
enforcement_body: National Intellectual Property Center of Georgia (Sakpatenti)
